content: कूर्चः, -र्चम् .²1 A bunch of any thing, a bundle. .²2 A handful of Kuśa grass; <ls>Mb. 14. 72. 10</ls>. .²3 A peacockʼs feather. .²4 The beard; आगतमनध्यायकारणं सविशेषभूतमद्य जीर्णकूर्चानाम् <ls>U. 4</ls>; or पूरयितव्यमनेन चित्रफलकं लम्बकूर्चानां तापसानां कदम्बैः <ls>Ś. 6</ls>. .²5 The tip of the thumb and the middle finger brought in contact so as to pinch <ab>&c.</ab> .²6 The upper part of the rose, the part (or hair) between the eye-brows. .²7 A brush. .²8 Deceit, fraud. .²9 Boasting, bragging. .²10 Hypocrisy. .{@-र्चः@} .²1 The head. .²2 A store-room. .²3 A seat of Kuśa grass (कुशासन); जनको ह वैदेहः कूर्चादुपावसर्पन्नुवाच <ls>Bṛ. Up. 4. 2. 1</ls>.
